# Narsil Workshop

> Narsil Workshop is a free, educational site that teaches, step by step, how to build Claude Code mods like Narsil (a status pet that shows above the prompt whether Claude is working, waiting, done, or stuck) and Narsil Check (a side panel that reviews the branch, CI, dependencies, and vulnerabilities), and a Narsil desk bot with a body (an ESP32-P4 touch screen in the belly and a holographic ESP32-S3 head) that talks through Xiaozhi and Claude on your own server and shows GitHub pull requests and the Narsil status.

The site is available in English, Spanish, Italian, French, and Brazilian Portuguese. It has no backend and no analytics, and it never asks for tokens or keys. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic, PBC; this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

## Learning paths

- Your own status pet: a mod like Narsil (states, animations, every conversation, floating window, voice, context and cache clocks, phone alerts)
- Your own review panel: a mod like Narsil Check (CI steps, branch behind its remote, dependency updates by risk, OSV.dev vulnerabilities, tools for Claude)
- A Narsil desk bot: an ESP32-P4 touch screen in the belly with tasks and pull requests, a holographic ESP32-S3 head with Narsil's face connected over UART, and a voice through Xiaozhi with Claude on a self-hosted server

Experimental: Narsil in Claude, an extension for Firefox and Vivaldi on Android that shows the Narsil status inside claude.ai. It relies on the structure of the claude.ai page, not on a public API, so a Claude update can break it.
